LiveContainer 3.8.0 
> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires SideStore 0.6.2+ or AltStore 2.2.1+ for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore ("LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa"), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details. 
New Features 
Storage Management 
• Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
• Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
• Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches. 
Multiple LiveContainers
• Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (1367) 
Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (1357) 
Multitasking 
• Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (1208)
• Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (1228, 1250)
• Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
• URL schemes and "open-url" payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows. 
JIT
• Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler. 
TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN 
Improvements
• Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (1194)
• IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
• Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
• Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
• Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
• Add a "Clear Notification" button (1388)
• Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (1417) 
Bug Fixes 
• Fixed "livecontainer://open-url" dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (1339)
• Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (1209)
• Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an "en.lproj" path. (1239)
• Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (1365, 1368)
• Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (1347)
• Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (1386)
• Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (1430)
• Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (1300, 1310, 1329)
• Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (1402, 844, 870)
• Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (13

>[!Note]
> This a minor release that solves the following issues in version 3.7.0 and adds the following features. For more information, please see [3.7.0 release note](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/3.7.0). 
Bug Fixes 
• Fix an issue where built-in SideStore may freeze on launch (1158)
• Fix the ipa of another LiveContainer not generating in LiveContainer+SideStore builds after SideStore's massive codebase change (1184)
• Fix the new Launch App Shortcut does not work below iOS 18 (1159)
• The Launch App Shortcut now reports meaningful errors
• Fix crash when using external container in multitasking mode
• Fix process hangs when debugging multitask private apps 
New Features
• The "Tap top of the view to scroll to top" action can be passed through to multitasking guest apps.

LiveContainer 3.7.0 
> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires SideStore 0.6.2+ or AltStore 2.2.1+ for installation.
> We recommend installing LiveContainer + SideStore using [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details. 
Happy Spring Festival / Lunar New Year! After six months of development, we’re excited to release LiveContainer 3.7.0. This update introduces several powerful new features, including the Launch App Shortcut, iOS 26 JIT script support, external containers, native icon generation, and more. 

New Features 
Launch App Shortcut 
> [!Note]
> This feature requires LiveContainer to be installed with at least the LaunchAppExtension and LaunchAppExtensionHelper extension. iOS 16+ is supported. 
A new extension allows apps to launch instantly without opening the LiveContainer main interface (for apps that are not locked, hidden, or JIT-required). Once configured, the shortcut prepares the runtime environment and selects an available LiveContainer instance to launch the app directly. 
This reduces extra relaunches and jumps and typically saves 1~2 seconds per launch. 
See the [setup guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/guides/add-to-home-screen) for instructions. 
JIT 
Support for iOS 26 JIT scripts has been added by @Vishal. Scripts can be configured in app-specific settings and loaded automatically on iOS 26+. 
The “StikDebug in another LiveContainer” option has been fixed, allowing StikDebug to run within LiveContainer. When launching a JIT-required app, LiveContainer will automatically detect StikDebug, launch it in an available container, and pass all required parameters — including scripts — to enable JIT. 
In addition, when enabling JIT for multitasked app, LiveContainer will prioritize launching StikDebug as a multitask app to save app slot usage. (TODO: this doesn’t automatically minimize StikDebug after enabling JIT, might be added later) 
Be sure to convert StikDebug into a shared app before use. 

External Containers 
> [!Note]
> Containers stored on external media (portable drives, SMB shares, etc.) are unsupported by many apps and may cause instability or crashes. 
You can now use external folders as app containers. This is useful if you want to manage app data through a file manager while still accessing it in LiveContainer, or if you want maintain container access when an app is shared. 
To configure this, open: 
App-Specific Settings → Select External Data Folder 
Native Icons 
LiveContainer now generates icons using native iOS libraries. On iOS 18+, this enables proper Light, Dark, and Original (Liquid Glass) icon rendering. These icons can also be saved for home screen shortcuts. 
Multitasking Improvements 
* Added “Skip app terminate screen” (by @boa-z)
* Added ”Single Window Mode” to minimize other apps when a maximized app is brought to front
* Launch URL schemes can now be passed to multitasking apps. Passing URL between multitask apps can be controlled via ”Redirect URL to Host” switch
* Launching Private Apps is now possible. By default, apps launched with private container is only given sandbox access to its own data container folder. You can change it in developer settings.
* Changed animations a little bit 
AltStore Source Support 
Basic AltSource support has been implemented by @StephenDev0. Sources can be added using: 
"""
livecontainer://sources?url=
""" 
Other Additions 
* App remarks are now supported (by @WingCH)
* Decrypted apps can now be installed via "itms-services" links (by @WingCH) 
Bug Fixes 
* Fixed iOS 26.4b1 compatibility (1152)
* Fixed crashes caused by "-[NSUserDefaults synchronize]" returning NO
* Fixed signing crashes when apps contain too many libraries (1135)
* Fixed signing failure when not enough space is available to insert HM_DYLIB in Mach-O headers (95
